name: GeoPilot Auto Play
description: Preflight route analysis, red hazard / cyan safe-surface classification, orb prediction, scan rays and pause control center.

controller-title.name: GeoPilot Controller
controller-title.description: Control the scanner and timing predictor.

auto-play.name: Enable Auto Play
auto-play.description: Follow the preflight route plan; avoid red hazards, land on reachable safe surfaces and time jump-activated orbs.

control-mode.name: Game Mode
control-mode.description: Auto detects the current player mode. Manual values override detection.

reaction-distance.name: Scanner Range
reaction-distance.description: Forward scan distance in game coordinate units.

lead-frames.name: Jump Lead (Frames)
lead-frames.description: Reaction lead measured in update frames. Raise slightly for faster sections; lower to reduce early jumps.

show-rays.name: Show Scan Rays
show-rays.description: Draw scan fan, object rays and boxes around recognized hazards.

show-hud.name: Show Timing HUD
show-hud.description: Show mode, frame counter, FPS, scanned objects, target, ETA and current action.

show-debug-log.name: Debug Log
show-debug-log.description: Log controller decisions to the Geode log once per second.

orb-assist.name: Orb Assist
orb-assist.description: Detect jump-activated orb types/IDs (yellow, blue, pink, green, red, black, spider, teleport and custom).
